_note: Each department names its projects its own way in its GROWS tracking sheet, and that tab carries no Project ID. Projects whose sheet name starts with their Air4 name are matched automatically; the ones listed here are not, and are pinned to a sheet row by name. A pin that stops matching (the department renamed the row) is reported as unmatched and the card simply shows no sheet progress — it never guesses. 'confidence': CONFIRMED = checked by Air4, HIGH = unambiguous, PENDING = awaiting confirmation.
